title:
Inspection reports,
ready for review.
caption: Readings, photos and findings flow into a draft for review and approval.

title:
The inspection is done.
Is the report still waiting?
sub: The readings are recorded. The photo is taken. Someone still has to assemble the report.
caption: See field entries become a report draft for the office.

title:
Site details are ready.
Add this inspection’s results.
sub: Open the site and system, then record the new readings.
caption: Previous readings are shown for comparison alongside the new entry fields.

title:
Record it in the field.
Carry it into the report.
sub: The technician enters the waterflow alarm time and main drain readings.
caption: The same values appear in the draft, without retyping them in the office.

title:
The photo comes
with the finding and location.
sub: A painted sprinkler in Room 214. The photo and note stay with the inspection.
caption: The reviewer can see which finding the photo documents.

title:
The data is in the draft.
Review can begin.
sub: Readings, findings and photos appear together in the report.
caption: The office checks the draft and resolves missing details before approval.

title:
Check each entry
against the field record.
sub: Open the submitted record and compare it with the draft.
caption: Office amendments retain a reason and the previous values.

title:
A detail is missing?
Keep the request with the job.
sub: The reviewer asks for the sprinkler location within Room 214.
caption: The technician receives the note inside the same inspection.

title:
Complete the detail.
Update the report.
sub: The technician adds the location and resubmits the inspection.
caption: The office sees the updated entries and continues the review.

title:
Approved for release.
Ready for the customer.
sub: The report includes the inspection results and the outstanding deficiency.
caption: Report approval does not close the deficiency. Its status stays visible.

title:
Start the next visit
with the history at hand.
sub: The current report and previous inspections stay with the same site.
caption: Open an earlier report to see what was inspected and what has changed.

title:
See it work
with your own report.
sub: Get a mobile form and the report draft it produces.
caption: Send a form and sample report. Within 3 business days; complex forms get an agreed delivery date.
